room.prompt: A calm wafer inspection station under restrained white light: a round wafer covered in a neat grid of small square dies lies on a dark stage, soft light from above, the rest of the room quiet and dim

stage.where: on the stage in front of the wafer
stage.near: one die of the grid is a little smaller than it

transistor.prompt: A simplified diagram for an animated film: a single switch-like transistor on a simple path, a signal of little light dots stopped at its closed gate, slate-blue and ochre, no labels

transistor2.prompt: the gate is open and the little dots of light flow through

transistor3.prompt: several more transistors in a row pass the dots of light along a simple path

w_whole.pose: standing proudly in front of a gridded wafer, arms out, presenting it

d_one.pose: a single small square die, stepping forward out of a neat grid, the only one with a face, pleased

d_watch.pose: small, looking up and to the right with interest
